entry.title: New: Resolution 389 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — GOEAC: Withdrawn by author - 02/06/24
entry.content:
AMENDS THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I BY AMENDING RULE NO. 23, BILLS AND RESOLUTIONS

Repeals Council Rule No. 23(1)(d), which requires that any bill or resolution that is amended at final reading be held over until the next regular meeting of the County Council.

Latest action: GOEAC: Withdrawn by author - 02/06/24
